Ryze 2 is a cluster pays slot set deep inside Ryze’s ever-growing treasure hoard, where ancient mint-forged Coins and shifting patterns awaken new magical defenses. Win with clusters of 5 or more adjacent symbols and watch the grid evolve through Avalanche drops, Multiplier Wilds, Coins with Coin Compress, Symbol Bursts, and Orb Powers. The maximum win is up to 10,000x your bet.

Bet amount and balance are always displayed in the info bar at the bottom of the game view in the currency that the player has chosen. This information is always available throughout the gaming session. Winnings are displayed in the selected currency in the middle of the info bar at the bottom of the game view when playing.
Wins are generated by clusters of five or more connected identical symbols, resulting in a varying number of ways to win. The RTP of the game is defined in the game rules.

The Bonus symbol triggers the Bonus game when it reaches the bottom of the game grid after the spin ends and no more wins remain. The Bonus game starts with 7 bonus drops. Bonus symbols that reach the bottom award 3 bonus drops, and the Bonus game can be upgraded to the Super Bonus game. In the Super Bonus game, Orb states persist and Multiplier Wilds remain sticky between bonus drops. Each bonus drop starts with an Orb Overload.

Multiplier Wild symbols substitute for any paying symbol. A Multiplier Wild symbol can contain a multiplier value. Multiplier Wilds additively apply to each other within the same cluster.

Coins show a value that is x times the bet. A cluster of Coins pays out its aggregate value and that value is then given to a new Coin that is left behind when the cluster is removed. The multiplier values of all Multiplier Wilds in a winning Coin cluster are added and the sum is then multiplied by the winning Coin cluster.

The burst symbol is a blocker symbol that is activated at the end of the game round when nothing else can happen. It changes itself and its adjacent symbols into the same payout symbol or into Coins, it does not transform into wild. Coins, bonus symbols and Multiplier Wilds are not affected.

A bonus symbol that reaches the bottom of the game grid triggers the Bonus game with 7 bonus drops. The Super Bonus game is triggered in case the Super Bonus symbol reached the bottom of the game grid.
Ryze 2 is a 7-row slot with an offset 6-5-6-5-6-5-6 symbol grid, dropping symbols and cluster wins.
The minimum bet is __MINBADEFBMODE__, and the maximum bet is __MAXBADEFBMODE__.
Each bet is __CPBB__ coins.
A winning cluster consists of 5 or more identical symbols which are either vertically or horizontally connected. Only the largest cluster of the connected identical symbols is paid out.
A game round starts on the selected bet level when the player hits the spin button.
The game can be played automatically by activating Auto Spin. Hold down the spin button or use the Auto Spin button to set the number of game rounds to be played automatically.
Winnings and winning combinations are paid out according to the paytable.
Winnings are presented in the player's currency or in coins. The player can change preference in Settings.
Winnings are presented in the player's currency.
Symbols drop vertically with gravity and slide to the left and right repeatedly as far downwards as possible. All symbols except wild symbols can fall through wild symbols.
Ryze 2 is played in two modes; normal mode and bonus mode with bonus drops.

All cluster wins in the current symbol drop are collected. Thereafter, all symbols that were part of a winning combination explode. The remaining symbols fall vertically until they reach a resting position and new symbols drop in to fill the empty spaces. The Avalanche feature continues as long as new winning combinations appear.
A winning cluster of solely payout symbols, not Coins, creates a x1 Multiplier Wild in one of the vacant positions created after a win.

When a win is formed, each Multiplier Wild that is part of the winning cluster increases its multiplier by 1 for every winning Coin or payout symbol in that cluster, then moves to one of the empty positions left after the winning symbols are removed.

The multiplier values of all Multiplier Wilds that are part of the same cluster are added and the sum is then multiplied by the winning cluster. After the win, the individual multipliers are increased before being added together and merged into a new Multiplier Wild.
The Multiplier Wild symbol substitutes for any symbol except the bonus and burst symbols.

Coins show a value that is x times the bet. A cluster of Coins pays out its aggregate value and that value is then given to a new Coin that is left behind when the cluster is removed. A cluster of solely Coin symbols does not create a Multiplier Wild.
The multiplier values of all Multiplier Wilds in a winning Coin cluster are added and the sum is then multiplied by the winning Coin cluster.

The Burst symbol is a blocker that activates at the end of the game round, when nothing more can happen. It transforms itself and adjacent payout symbols into the same payout symbol type or into Coins, it does not transform into wild. Coins may receive individual values. Bonus symbols, Burst symbols, Coin symbols, and Multiplier Wild symbols are not affected.
If more than one burst symbol is in view, they activate simultaneously but resolve one by one.
If a burst symbol activates adjacent to a dormant Orb, that Orb may be powered.

The burst symbol activates before any Orb Overload and before the Bonus game starts if a Bonus game is triggered in the same drop. During the Bonus game, the burst symbol activates before any additional bonus drops or Orb Overloads are awarded if another Bonus game trigger occurs in the same bonus drop. The burst symbol activates at the end of the bonus drop if no further events can occur.

Orb Overload: If all 6 Orbs are powered during a single game round, an Orb Overload triggers at the end of the game round. The powered orbs are activated one by one, and each orb performs a random orb power, which may sometimes have no effect. After an Orb Overload, they reset and can be powered again in the same game round.
The spawn wild feature selects either an empty symbol space on the game grid or a symbol that is not part of a win, and converts it into a Multiplier Wild.
Spawn Greater Wild converts either an empty symbol space or one payout symbol that is not part of a win into a Multiplier Wild with an increased multiplier value.
Empower Wild selects a Multiplier Wild and doubles its multiplier value.
The spawn coin feature selects either an empty symbol space on the game grid or a symbol that is not part of a win, and converts it into a Coin with a random value.
Symbol Shift selects one payout symbol type and converts all symbols of that type into a higher value symbol type.
Spawn Burst converts either an empty symbol space or one payout symbol that is not part of a win into a Symbol Burst.

A Bonus symbol that reaches the bottom of the game grid triggers the Bonus game with 7 bonus drops. During the Bonus game Multiplier Wilds remain sticky between bonus drops. Bonus symbols that reach the bottom award 3 bonus drops, and the Bonus game can be upgraded to the Super Bonus game if a Super Bonus symbol reaches the bottom.

When a Super Bonus symbol reaches the bottom of the game grid, the Super Bonus game is triggered with 7 bonus drops. In the Super Bonus game Multiplier Wilds remain sticky between bonus drops. Each bonus drop starts with an Orb Overload.
The Bonus game and Super Bonus game end when no bonus drops remain or when the win cap has been reached.
Winnings are paid out at the end of the bonus mode.
No bets can be changed during an ongoing game round.
A game round is immediately ended when the win cap is reached, and the wins collected so far will be paid out.
The theoretical payout (RTP) in Ryze 2 is __RTP__.
The game will be capped at __TBB__ the placed bet.
In the event of malfunction all bets and wins are void.

The X-iter feature offers several different game modes.
Super Bonus: Guaranteed entry to the Super Bonus game at the cost of __X05_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet. Each bonus drop begins with an Orb Overload and Multiplier Wilds are sticky.
Bonus: Guaranteed entry to the Bonus game at the cost of __X04_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet. Multiplier Wilds are sticky throughout the Bonus game.
Orb Overload: Start with an Orb Overload at the cost of __X03_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
Mega Bonus Hunt: One spin with more than 8 times the chance to trigger the bonus and Super Bonus game at the cost of __X02_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
Bonus Hunt: One spin with more than 4 times the chance to trigger the bonus and Super Bonus game at the cost of __X01_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
The X-iter features can only be activated in the base game.
The minimum X-iter cost is __MINBABMODE__, and the maximum cost is __MAXBABMODE__.
The theoretical payout (RTP) for all X-iter game modes in Ryze 2 is __RTP__.
All game rules apply for the X-iter features as well.
